text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Outside her store, Tsumugi is approached by an adoring fan.
text_block_list.orig_text: 店の前で、ツムギは通りすがりのファンから声をかけられていた。

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: Tsumugi! I can't wait for your solo concert!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ツムギちゃん！
　ソロライブ楽しみにしてるよ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much! I'll do my best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございまーす！
　頑張りますっ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: *sigh*... My solo concert...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～……
ソロライブかぁ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Damn that Nozomi! How could she organize a solo concert without asking me?!
And a new single for me to release, too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ノゾミさんめぇ～！
　またしても勝手に私のソロライブなんか計画して！
おまけに新曲まで用意されてて……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
All I wanted was to be a supporting act
to the real stars, Nozomi and Chika...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あくまで
ノゾミさんとチカさんのおまけだと思ってたんだけどなぁ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Will anyone really come just to see me perform on my own?
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に
私だけのライブにお客さんが来てくれるのかな……？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Me, up on stage alone? That's such a weird thought...
I can't imagine it at all. Oh, what am I going to do...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私
一人でステージに立つとか、
実感わかないし……
全っ然想像出来ない。
あ～もうどうすれば……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...
choice_data_list: That was quite the deep sigh.
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Wait, Mr. Knight?!
Where did you come from?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ……
って、
騎士さん！？
　なんですか
急に現れて！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
E-even I feel like sighing every now and again!
I don't have my head in the clouds like you do!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
私だって
ため息くらいつきますよ！
騎士さんみたいにノーテンキじゃありませんからっ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I'm not angry! I'm just in a bind!
Sorry for shouting... It's nice to see you, Mr. Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
怒ってません！
　困ってるんです！
いきなり怒鳴ってすみません……
こんにちは、
騎士さん。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I know it's not good for me to look grumpy...
But I'm really not sure what to do right now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
不機嫌そうな顔しちゃダメですよね……
でも
今回は本当にどうしようもないんですよ～……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Aw, geez...
Thanks to you, I'm feeling even more anxious now!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あーもうっ！
騎士さんのせいで
余計にナーバスになっちゃいました！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's not like this is anything you can help me with, though.
Don't worry about it. It's my own personal issue.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああでも、
騎士さんに相談してどうにかなる悩みじゃないので、
気にしなくてもいいです。
これは私だけの問題ですから。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: The thing is, I have a solo concert coming up...
choice_data_list: A concert? I want to go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
実は今度、
ソロでライブしなきゃいけなくなって……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
No, please don't! Wait, hold up!
Are you leaving already?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
来なくていいですー
ってちょっとぉ！
もう行っちゃうんですか！？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I can't believe he just ran off...
text_block_list.orig_text:
言うだけ言って
あの人は……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't possibly sing those lyrics in front of Mr. Knight,
so I really hope he doesn't come...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんな歌詞の歌、
騎士さんの前で歌えるわけないから、
見に来て欲しくないんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
And besides... If he keeps being so nice to me,
I might be tempted... to rely on him...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに……
今騎士さんに優しくされたら、
私……
絶対頼っちゃう……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: That evening...
text_block_list.orig_text: ──その日の夜。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
That makes two full rehearsals...
Wow, I'm beat...
text_block_list.orig_text:
二度目の通しリハ終わり……
疲れたぁ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I need a break...
text_block_list.orig_text: ちょっと休憩しよ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: *sigh*...
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁ……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: My singing and dancing are OK now...
text_block_list.orig_text: 歌も踊りも大丈夫……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: This new song's lyrics... It was Nozomi who wrote them, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
新曲の歌詞……
ノゾミさんが書いたんだよね……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: A song about a girl struggling to share her real feelings...
text_block_list.orig_text:
素直になれない女の子が、
気持ちを伝えたい歌……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
And she thought it was perfect for me...?
Sometimes it feels like Nozomi is almost too perceptive...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これが私にピッタリって……
ノゾミさんは私のこと、
どこまでお見通しなんだろ……？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
It's almost like she thinks I have feelings for Mr...
No, no, that's ridiculous... Ahhh, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
これじゃあまるで
私が騎士さんのこと……
いやいや、
そんなこと……
いやでも～……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Besides, Mr. Knight already has Rei, so...
text_block_list.orig_text:
大体、
騎士さんにはレイ様が……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no! I have to focus on the concert!
And I decided this song is a love song for Rei and my fans!
text_block_list.orig_text:
違ーう！
　今はライブに集中！
それにこの曲は、
レイ様とファンへのラブソングなんだから！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm dedicating it to everyone who supports me!
So it's definitely not about anyone in particular...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう！
　これはみんなへの想いを歌ってるの！
だから、
特定の誰かに向けた歌じゃなくて……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Someone's coming this way?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ……？
　誰かこっちに来る……？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Mr. Knight?! Why do you always show up so suddenly?!
W-well, suddenly means suddenly!
It felt sudden to me, all right?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
騎士さん！？
　なんでいつもいきなり現れるんですか！？
い、
いきなりはいきなりです！
　私にとってはいきなりだったんです！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Could it be you've been following me around?
You'd better not try anything funny!
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかして騎士さんって、
私を尾行してるんですか？
やめてくださいねそういうのは！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Do you do this to all the girls you meet?!
Oh, you creeper! What am I going to do with you?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まさか
私以外の女の子にも……！？
あぁやだやだ！
　まったくもうこれだから……！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: You really are hopeless...
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に……
あなたって人は……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight... Is it OK if I talk to you about something?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……騎士さん。
ちょっとだけ、
私の話を聞いてもらえますか？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, you helped me before
when I wasn't sure what to do, didn't you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば、
前にも、
話聞いてもらっちゃいましたね……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I never dreamed for a moment
that I'd end up doing a solo concert...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの時は
私がソロでライブをやることになるとは、
思ってませんでした……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Now, I don't want to back out of being an idol.
I made my decision, and I'll follow through.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アイドルを途中で投げ出すつもりはありません。
出来る限り頑張るつもりです。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
But I like to help other people shine, not take center stage myself.
I feel like I'm already doing enough of my own work.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……私は私じゃなくて、
他の誰かを輝かせるのが好きなんです。
それに自分のことは、
十分やってるつもりです。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: So I'm not sure if it's really my place to put on a solo performance...
choice_data_list: Your fans want to see you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな私が、
本当にソロで活動するべきなのかなって思うんです……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
My fans, huh...?
Now that you mention it, I guess
that guy we captured before was a fan of mine, too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ファンですか……
……そういえば、
この間
一緒に捕まえた人も、
私のファンでしたね……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I have more fans than I realized...
Did you know? It actually feels kind of good
to have people cheer you on.
text_block_list.orig_text:
意外といるんですよね、
私のファンって……
知ってますか？
　応援されるのって、
案外悪くないんですよ？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
If there really are people who'd do that for me...
People who care about my performing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな人たちが、
少しでもいるなら……
応援してくれる人がいるなら……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I guess I might be able to try a little harder...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私、
頑張れるかも知れません……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I did work hard to put this costume together!
It would be a waste not to wear it. And besides...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ
一生懸命素材集めて作った服ですし？
着ないともったいないですよね。
それに──

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Even if I can't dance like Nozomi or sing as beautifully as Chika,
I want to at least understand them, so I can discuss their performances
and help them however I can.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ノゾミさんより踊れなくても、
チカさんより歌えなくても……
出来るだけ
二人と近い目線で、
振り付けや歌について、
ある程度の目線で話せるようになりたいんです。

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard it is, that's what I need to do right now.
To help them shine even brighter in the costumes I design,
I can't spare any effort!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それがどんなに大変でも、
今の私に必要なことだし、
それで
私の作った服を着る人たちが
最高に輝くなら、
やるしかないんです！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
There are people I want to see shine up there...
And people who want to see me shine, too...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私には、
輝かせたい人がいる……
輝く私を好きな人がいる……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Anything that'll help someone shine in my costumes
is something worth doing. Even if that \"someone\" is me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
──自分の作った服を着る人が最高に輝くなら、
やるしかないですよね……
例えそれが、
私自身でも……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: To achieve that, I think... I can do just about anything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そのためなら、
私は……
どんなことでも頑張れます！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Somehow I feel much more motivated now!
All right! Let's make this solo concert a massive success!
choice_data_list: I'm glad you're back to normal.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだか元気になってきました！
よ～し！
　ソロライブ、
絶対成功させるぞ～！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Seeing me in my element makes you happy, does it?
Then you must be satisfied now! No need to come to the concert!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
調子の戻った私を見て嬉しいんですか？
じゃあもう満足ですよね？
　ライブは見に来なくていいです！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
But when the day rolls around, if you're horribly bored,
with so little to do you feel like you might drop dead from sheer tedium,
I guess you could come and watch just a little bit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……当日
どうしても暇で
退屈で
もう今にも死にそうだーって思うくらい、
することがなかった時だけ、
見に来てもいいですよ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The day of the concert...
text_block_list.orig_text: ライブ当日……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to be on my own out there,
but I know I can make this a success!
Here we go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日のライブ……
一人だけど、
絶対成功させてみせます！
行っくぞぉー！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Hey, everyone! Welcome to my very first solo concert!
Thank you for coming!
I'm gonna give it my all, so I hope you have a great time!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなー！
　今日は
私のソロライブに来てくれて、
ありがとうございまーすっ！
精一杯頑張るので、
楽しんでいってくださーいっ！

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Tsumugiiiii!
text_block_list.orig_text: ツムギちゃーん！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
Wow, all that cheering... And the smiles of my fans...!
It's just like Mr. Knight said...
With all these people supporting me, I can do anything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい歓声……
それに、
ファンの笑顔……！
騎士さんの言う通り、
この人たちがいるから、
私、
頑張れるっ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: All right, for the first song... I'd like to introduce my new single!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それじゃあまず一曲目、
聞いてください……
新曲です！

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: Foooo～！！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I've just gotta sing, and dance, and perform!
text_block_list.orig_text:
とにかく精一杯歌って、
踊って、
頑張って！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I don't know how this will go, but I'll give it my all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
どこまで出来るか分からないけど、
全力で！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: I'm ready to convey my feelings... to you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の中の気持ち……
「あなた」に届けます！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: So I hope you're listening out there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だから……
ちゃんと聞いててくださいね！

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Yeaaahhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: うおおおおおっ！

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Tsumugiiiiiiii!
text_block_list.orig_text: ツムギちゃーん！！！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
These people are all my fans... and they're having so much fun...
Mr. Knight, you were right all along...
I'm so glad I worked hard to do this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
この人たち、
みんな私のファンで、
こんなに楽しんでくれてる……
騎士さん、
あなたの言う通りでした……
私、
頑張って良かったです！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
We're only just getting started here!
I hope you're ready for a heck of a show!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだまだ盛り上げていきますからね～！
みなさんも、
全力でついて来てくださーい！

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Yeeeahhhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: イェーイ！！！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: And that's a wrap, team!
text_block_list.orig_text: お疲れ様でしたー！

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text: Great work out there!
text_block_list.orig_text: お疲れ様でーす！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Whew... I'm beat...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー
疲れたー……

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: Mr. Knight?! Ambushing the star is forbidden, you know?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……騎士さん！？
　出待ちは禁止なんですけど！？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I'm kidding. So you actually came, huh. Thank you.
So, about today's performance... How... was it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
冗談です。
来てくれてたんですね。
ありがとうございます。
今日のライブ、
どう……
でした？

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
I was so relieved that everyone seemed to like my new song.
You thought it was good too, right? The lyrics are—
text_block_list.orig_text:
新曲、
みんな喜んでくれて
ホッとしました。
騎士さんもいい曲だったと思いません？
　
歌詞だって──

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text:
...A-actually, forget that part! Don't say anything at all!
Ummm... It's not like you have much in the way of taste!
Your opinions are sure to be lame!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──や、
やっぱりいいです！
　何も言わないでください！
えーっと
騎士さんの感想って
月並みでほら、
面白みに欠けてそうですからっ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Failing to ask {0} for his honest opinion,
Tsumugi scrambled to cover for herself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}に感想を素直に聞けず、
つい誤魔化してしまったツムギだった。
